verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so asking whether its source code is available under an open license is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships software whose source could be published; the llms.txt file and the downloadable whitepaper are content, not source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
